status: Source-level integration design; no implementation or device qualification

source_findings.finding: Dispatch uses physical GetBlockIdx and 64 vector workers. Workers0..31 handle hidden transfer/local expansion/forwarding;32..63 run the independent auxiliary gate-weight pipeline, and scales additionally when fp8 is enabled. BF16 does not eliminate the weight pipeline.
Auxiliary owner is physical GetBlockIdx minus32, with peer stride32. A P4 subblock1-only call cannot preserve this owner assignment without an explicit logical-role parameter.

Descriptor prelude caches Clos directories, physical AIV0 publishes outgoing addresses/generation, then calls SyncAll<true>. Calling the unchanged prelude on only half the vector workers changes both publisher selection and collective participation. Mixed AIC/AIV barrier semantics must be established; do not assume this call remains valid.

Physical AIV7 is the sole incoming terminal poller. It waits aggregate source/lane generation notifications; kernel completion joins the other workers. This is whole-Dispatch completion, not a per128-row expert-tile readiness contract.
Every returning Dispatch worker calls aclshmemx_mte_quiet. Queue-owner URMA completion and incoming notifications are separate from this local MTE drain; none may be replaced by a plain ready store.

P4 runs activation only on subblock0, maps logical cube group using GetBlockIdx/GetSubBlockNum, and leaves subblock1 idle. GU readiness follows FIX_S; Act readiness follows MTE3_S. Down waits all actual intermediate tiles for its M tile. P4 currently assumes Xe is already fully available.

Direct physical worker IDs also appear in peer-plan distribution, directory-cache selection in peer_transport.hpp:681, and scale_pipeline.hpp. Refactoring only the top-level Dispatch core variable would leave inconsistent assignments.

proposed_design_not_yet_implemented: Keep the current compute-only P4 component frozen while establishing its native GU/A/Z correctness. Build any SHMEM integration as a separate candidate and independently qualify it.

Introduce explicit logical communication worker ID/count through all helpers before assigning communication to subblock1. Enumerate every physical GetBlockIdx use, profile index, scratch owner, QP owner and initialization participant; preserve the native hidden/weight protocol until each mapping is accounted for.

Use a finite descriptor/init prelude with explicit participants and completion generation before workers diverge. AIC must not read Xe early; activation workers must not enter waits that prevent completion of the prelude. Prove mixed-kernel barrier participation rather than retaining SyncAll by analogy.

Evaluate either a partitioned hidden/weight communication role map or phased reuse of32 communication workers. Phased hidden then weight may overlap compute with weights because GU/A/Z are unweighted, but requires proving no hidden, relay, terminal or buffer-recycling path depends on auxiliary progress. It is a hypothesis, not an approved implementation.

Publish Xe-ready for an expert M tile only after all its actual contributing source segments have completed transfer and expert expansion. Remote transport completion, local MTE completion and destination visibility must precede the publication. Whole-peer terminal flags are insufficient for early per-tile consumption.
Keep unweighted Z saved for dp including zero-gate routes. Gate-weight-ready can be separate from Xe-ready, but combine/reduction cannot consume a route until both Z and its weight are ready.

For future reusable chunk buffers, bind source completion, ready, consumption and reclamation to rank/step/chunk/buffer epoch. Current P4 private invocation flags are not evidence that a recycled ring is safe. Retain final transport drains and complete rank joins after the last chunk.
required_discriminating_checks: Static role/DAG accounting must cover all required hidden/auxiliary producers, including empty ranks and source tiles spanning multiple peers. Prove there is no cycle involving initialization, incoming wait, activation or buffer reclaim.

After review and compilation, a separate bounded small-shape device qualification must compare saved Xe/GU/A/Z and full gradients with fixed limits, cold/skew/zero_gate/empty routes, repeated epochs and exact loaded libraries. The current P4 component test alone cannot establish transport correctness.

Only after complete correctness and lifecycle qualification, use equal-scope communication-only, compute-only, forced-serial and fused controls plus device timeline evidence. Thirty-two idle subblock1 lanes in source do not prove bandwidth availability or hardware overlap.
